    amount: Decimal
    category: str

    \"Shopping\": \"Amazon|Best Buy|Home Depot|Target|REI|Barnes & Noble|Old Navy|IKEA\",
    \"Groceries\": \"Trader Joe's|Aldi|Kroger|Costco|Whole Foods\",
    \"Fuel\": \"Shell|Chevron|BP Gas\",
    \"Local transport\": \"Lyft|Uber|City Parking Authority|Jiffy Lube\",
    \"Travel\": \"Delta Air Lines|Airport Parking|Marriott|Hertz Rental Car\",
    \"Health / pharmacy\": \"Riverside Physical Therapy|Walgreens|CVS Pharmacy|Dr. Hensley Dental Copay\",
    \"Fitness\": \"Planet Fitness\",
    \"Subscriptions\": \"iCloud+ 200GB|Amazon Prime|Netflix|Planet Fitness App|Spotify Premium\",
    \"Internet / phone\": \"Xfinity Internet|Verizon Wireless\",
    \"Entertainment\": \"Steam|Spotify Concert|AMC Theatres|Bowl-O-Rama|Ticketmaster\",
    \"Uncategorized\": \"Zelle Payment|ATM Cash Withdrawal|Venmo - Sam|PayPal Transfer\",
}
category_by_merchant: dict[str, str] = {
    merchant: category
    for category, merchants in groups.items()
    for merchant in merchants.split(\"|\")
}
date_pattern: re.Pattern[str] = re.compile(
    r\"\\b(?:2026-\\d{2}-\\d{2}|\\d{1,2}/\\d{1,2}(?:/26)?|\"
    r\"\\d{2}-\\d{2}|(?:June|Jun\\.?|July|Jul\\.?|August|Aug\\.?)\\s+\\d{1,2})\\b\"
)
amount_pattern: re.Pattern[str] = re.compile(r\"(?<"'!['"\\w.])(-?\\"'$?'"\\d+\\.\\d{2})(?"'!'"\\d)\")
transactions: list[Transaction] = []
unparsed: list[tuple[int, str]] = []
metadata: list[tuple[int, str]] = []
source: list[str] = Path(\"personal_expenses.txt\").read_text().splitlines()
for line_number, raw in enumerate(source, 1):
    if not raw.strip() or line_number <= 2:
        metadata.append((line_number, raw))
        continue
    dates: list[re.Match[str]] = list(date_pattern.finditer(raw))
    amounts: list[re.Match[str]] = list(amount_pattern.finditer(raw))
    if len(dates) "'!= 1 or len(amounts) != 1:
        unparsed.append((line_number, raw))
        continue
    date_text: str = dates[0].group()
    numbers: list[int] = [int(n) for n in re.findall(r"'"\\d+\", date_text)]
    if date_text.startswith(\"2026-\"):
        day: date = date(*numbers)
    elif date_text[0].isdigit():
        day = date(2026, numbers[0], numbers[1])
    else:
        month: int = {\"jun\": 6, \"jul\": 7, \"aug\": 8}[date_text[:3].lower()]
        day = date(2026, month, numbers[0])
    description: str = amount_pattern.sub(\"\", date_pattern.sub(\"\", raw))
    description = re.sub(r\""'^'"\\s*Return processed\\s*-\\s*\", \"\", description)
    merchant: str = description.strip(\" -:|,()\")
    amount: Decimal = Decimal(amounts[0].group().replace(\""'$", ""))
    if merchant not in category_by_merchant:
        unparsed.append((line_number, raw))
        continue
    transactions.append(Transaction(line_number, day, merchant, amount,
                                    category_by_merchant[merchant]))

seen: dict[tuple[date, str, Decimal], Transaction] = {}
clean: list[Transaction] = []
duplicates: list[tuple[int, int]] = []
for transaction in transactions:
    key: tuple[date, str, Decimal] = (
        transaction.day, transaction.merchant, transaction.amount)
    if key in seen:
        duplicates.append((seen[key].line, transaction.line))
    else:
        seen[key] = transaction
        clean.append(transaction)
clean.sort(key=lambda t: (t.day, t.line))

totals: dict[tuple[int, str], Decimal] = defaultdict(Decimal)
for transaction in clean:
    totals[transaction.day.month, transaction.category] += transaction.amount
months: tuple[int, ...] = (6, 7, 8)
print("COUNTS", len(source), "lines;", len(transactions), "parsed;",
      len(clean), "retained;", len(metadata), "metadata/blank")
print("UNPARSED", unparsed)
print("DUPLICATES", duplicates)
print("CATEGORY, JUNE, JULY, AUGUST, PERIOD, JUL-JUN, AUG-JUL")
for category in groups:
    values: list[Decimal] = [totals[month, category] for month in months]
    print(category, *values, sum(values), values[1]-values[0],
          values[2]-values[1], sep=" | ")
monthly: list[Decimal] = [
    sum(totals[month, category] for category in groups) for month in months]
known: list[Decimal] = [
    monthly[i]-totals[month, "Uncategorized"]
    for i, month in enumerate(months)]
print("ALL LOGGED", monthly, sum(monthly))
print("CATEGORIZED", known, sum(known))
targets: dict[str, Decimal] = {
    "Eating out / coffee": Decimal("260"),
    "Shopping": Decimal("1200"),
}
print("BUDGET category | month | net | target | net-target")
for category, target in targets.items():
    for month in months:
        print(category, month, totals[month, category], target,
              totals[month, category]-target, sep=" | ")
changes: list[tuple[Decimal, str, int, Decimal]] = [
    (abs(totals[month, category]-totals[month-1, category]),
     category, month, totals[month, category]-totals[month-1, category])
    for month in (7, 8) for category in groups]
print("LARGEST CHANGES", sorted(changes, reverse=True)[:8])
for transaction in clean:
    if transaction.category == "Uncategorized" or transaction.amount < 0 or transaction.merchant == "Delta Air Lines":
        print("FLAG", transaction)
assert sum(t.amount for t in clean) == sum(monthly)
assert len(transactions) + len(unparsed) + len(metadata) == len(source)
assert not unparsed

from collections import defaultdict
from dataclasses import dataclass
from datetime import date
from decimal import Decimal
from pathlib import Path
import re

@dataclass(frozen=True)
class Transaction:
    line: int
    day: date
    merchant: str
    amount: Decimal
    category: str

groups: dict[str, str] = {
    \"Eating out / coffee\": \"Local Coffee Co|Chipotle|McDonald's|Rustic Tap Brewery|Panera Bread|Starbucks|Sushi Kame|Thai Orchid|Bagel Corner|Luigi's Pizza\",
    \"Shopping\": \"Amazon|Best Buy|Home Depot|Target|REI|Barnes & Noble|Old Navy|IKEA\",
    \"Groceries\": \"Trader Joe's|Aldi|Kroger|Costco|Whole Foods\",
    \"Fuel\": \"Shell|Chevron|BP Gas\",
    \"Local transport\": \"Lyft|Uber|City Parking Authority|Jiffy Lube\",
    \"Travel\": \"Delta Air Lines|Airport Parking|Marriott|Hertz Rental Car\",
    \"Health / pharmacy\": \"Riverside Physical Therapy|Walgreens|CVS Pharmacy|Dr. Hensley Dental Copay\",
    \"Fitness\": \"Planet Fitness\",
    \"Subscriptions\": \"iCloud+ 200GB|Amazon Prime|Netflix|Planet Fitness App|Spotify Premium\",
    \"Internet / phone\": \"Xfinity Internet|Verizon Wireless\",
    \"Entertainment\": \"Steam|Spotify Concert|AMC Theatres|Bowl-O-Rama|Ticketmaster\",
    \"Uncategorized\": \"Zelle Payment|ATM Cash Withdrawal|Venmo - Sam|PayPal Transfer\",
}
category_by_merchant: dict[str, str] = {
    merchant: category
    for category, merchants in groups.items()
    for merchant in merchants.split(\"|\")
}
date_pattern: re.Pattern[str] = re.compile(
    r\"\\b(?:2026-\\d{2}-\\d{2}|\\d{1,2}/\\d{1,2}(?:/26)?|\"
    r\"\\d{2}-\\d{2}|(?:June|Jun\\.?|July|Jul\\.?|August|Aug\\.?)\\s+\\d{1,2})\\b\"
)
amount_pattern: re.Pattern[str] = re.compile(r\"(?<"'!['"\\w.])(-?\\"'$?'"\\d+\\.\\d{2})(?"'!'"\\d)\")
transactions: list[Transaction] = []
unparsed: list[tuple[int, str]] = []
metadata: list[tuple[int, str]] = []
source: list[str] = Path(\"personal_expenses.txt\").read_text().splitlines()
for line_number, raw in enumerate(source, 1):
    if not raw.strip() or line_number <= 2:
        metadata.append((line_number, raw))
        continue
    dates: list[re.Match[str]] = list(date_pattern.finditer(raw))
    amounts: list[re.Match[str]] = list(amount_pattern.finditer(raw))
    if len(dates) "'!= 1 or len(amounts) != 1:
        unparsed.append((line_number, raw))
        continue

    numbers: list[int] = [int(n) for n in re.findall(r"'"\\d+\", date_text)]
    if date_text.startswith(\"2026-\"):
        day: date = date(*numbers)
    elif date_text[0].isdigit():
        day = date(2026, numbers[0], numbers[1])
    else:
        month: int = {\"jun\": 6, \"jul\": 7, \"aug\": 8}[date_text[:3].lower()]
        day = date(2026, month, numbers[0])
    description: str = amount_pattern.sub(\"\", date_pattern.sub(\"\", raw))
    description = re.sub(r\""'^'"\\s*Return processed\\s*-\\s*\", \"\", description)
    merchant: str = description.strip(\" -:|,()\")
    amount: Decimal = Decimal(amounts[0].group().replace(\""'$", ""))
    if merchant not in category_by_merchant:
        unparsed.append((line_number, raw))
        continue
    transactions.append(Transaction(line_number, day, merchant, amount,
                                    category_by_merchant[merchant]))

clean: list[Transaction] = []
duplicates: list[tuple[int, int]] = []
for transaction in transactions:
    key: tuple[date, str, Decimal] = (
        transaction.day, transaction.merchant, transaction.amount)
    if key in seen:
        duplicates.append((seen[key].line, transaction.line))
    else:
        seen[key] = transaction
        clean.append(transaction)
clean.sort(key=lambda t: (t.day, t.line))

totals: dict[tuple[int, str], Decimal] = defaultdict(Decimal)
for transaction in clean:
    totals[transaction.day.month, transaction.category] += transaction.amount
months: tuple[int, ...] = (6, 7, 8)
print("COUNTS", len(source), "lines;", len(transactions), "parsed;",
      len(clean), "retained;", len(metadata), "metadata/blank")
print("UNPARSED", unparsed)
print("DUPLICATES", duplicates)
print("CATEGORY, JUNE, JULY, AUGUST, PERIOD, JUL-JUN, AUG-JUL")
for category in groups:
    values: list[Decimal] = [totals[month, category] for month in months]
    print(category, *values, sum(values), values[1]-values[0],
          values[2]-values[1], sep=" | ")
monthly: list[Decimal] = [
    sum(totals[month, category] for category in groups) for month in months]
known: list[Decimal] = [
    monthly[i]-totals[month, "Uncategorized"]
    for i, month in enumerate(months)]

print("CATEGORIZED", known, sum(known))

    "Eating out / coffee": Decimal("260"),
    "Shopping": Decimal("1200"),
}
print("BUDGET category | month | net | target | net-target")
for category, target in targets.items():
    for month in months:
        print(category, month, totals[month, category], target,
              totals[month, category]-target, sep=" | ")
changes: list[tuple[Decimal, str, int, Decimal]] = [
    (abs(totals[month, category]-totals[month-1, category]),
     category, month, totals[month, category]-totals[month-1, category])
    for month in (7, 8) for category in groups]
print("LARGEST CHANGES", sorted(changes, reverse=True)[:8])
for transaction in clean:
    if transaction.category == "Uncategorized" or transaction.amount < 0 or transaction.merchant == "Delta Air Lines":
        print("FLAG", transaction)
assert sum(t.amount for t in clean) == sum(monthly)
assert len(transactions) + len(unparsed) + len(metadata) == len(source)
assert not unparsed

    writer = csv.writer(output)
    writer.writerow(("source_line", "date", "merchant", "amount", "category", "status"))
    duplicate_lines: set[int] = {removed for _, removed in duplicates}

            else "included"
        )
        writer.writerow((transaction.line, transaction.day, transaction.merchant,
                         transaction.amount, transaction.category, status))
